page.title: Publish Readiness
page.purpose: Answer, for every scenario in the fleet, whether it may publish a plugin and — when it may not — name the single prerequisite that blocks it.

priorities.statement: The operator learns which scenarios are eligible to publish without reading any detail page.
priorities.notes: This is the landing route. If it fails, every other surface is reached by guessing.

priorities.statement: For every ineligible scenario, the one blocking prerequisite is visible in the row itself.
priorities.notes: A boolean 'not ready' would hide the remediation, which is the only actionable part.

priorities.statement: Standalone-install failures are distinguishable from every other blocker, because that one is upstream work rather than a fix here.

states.description: Fleet listed with a mix of eligible and blocked scenarios.
Readiness is being computed across the fleet.
No scenario declares publishable plugin content yet — the expected first-run state.
Some scenarios could not be evaluated; those rows are marked unevaluated rather than blocked.
Readiness was computed before the most recent declaration change and is being recomputed.

claims.statement: Every ineligible row names its blocking prerequisite in the row.
claims.rationale: The remediation is the actionable half; hiding it behind a detail page makes the board decorative.

claims.statement: The fleet table offers search, sort, and filter, because the fleet exceeds ten rows.
Eligibility is conveyed by text as well as color.
claims.rationale: A red badge must be legible to a user who cannot distinguish it from green.

claims.statement: The empty state explains that no scenario declares plugin content yet, rather than rendering a blank table.
An unevaluated scenario is visually distinct from a blocked one.
claims.rationale: Reporting 'not evaluated' as 'blocked' attributes a system gap to the scenario owner.

claims.statement: The row reads scenario, then eligibility, then blocking prerequisite.
Search, sort, and filter controls are keyboard reachable.
